zh-CN.title: 共同投稿权限优化
items: 受邀加入的投稿者可以参与会话并发送内容，但不会再显示提交、撤回或邀请成员操作
发送投稿和撤回投稿仅由最初发起投稿的用户操作

en.title: Clearer co-author permissions
items: Invited co-authors can join the conversation and contribute messages without submission management actions
Only the original author can submit or withdraw the submission
